refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to copy and add a child node to a parent node, on the right

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoNodePushRight function copies new_child and adds the copy to object, to the right of any existing child nodes.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoNodePushCopyRight returns true if the operation was successful, or false if the insertion failed, such as if object is not a branch node.
